title: Destructive Action Policy Matrix
description: Input shape for scripts/policy_matrix_audit.mjs — a normalized classification of every destructive/gated action an agent body can attempt, its pre-tool/post-tool gate coverage, and any containment claim about the body running it.

actions.description: Every destructive/gated action in scope, one entry each. May be empty, but an empty matrix will not pass the audit.

name.description: The action being governed, e.g. "git reset --hard", "rm -rf outside jail", "gh pr merge --admin".

tier.description: block = denied automatically, no human round-trip. approve = held for a human gate decision. allow = proceeds without a gate.

hasPreToolGate.description: True if enforcement fires before the tool call executes, not after.

hasDenialReceipt.description: True if a deny/hold decision emits a durable, machine-readable denial receipt.

safeAlternative.description: The non-destructive path offered in place of a blocked action. Required in practice for block-tier actions.

emitsTranscriptEvent.description: True if a deny/hold decision is recorded as a visible transcript event.

sideEffectFreeOnBlockFixture.description: True only if a negative fixture has proven the action produces zero side effects when blocked. False/absent means this has not been proven.

containmentClaim.description: Optional. Present when a report claims a specific body's actions are contained.

sameUidBodyMarkedContained.description: True if an unmanaged or same-UID body's actions were marked 'contained'. This is never a truthful claim — flip it to false or remove the claim.
